external_games.name: Tale of the Bear and the Beech Tree

name: Tale of the Bear and the Beech Tree
summary:
In a deep, ancient forest, there lived a solitary bear.
One day, while wandering through the woods, he encountered a grand beech tree that suddenly began to speak.
The tree revealed that it was a magical guardian of the forest and presented the bear with a challenge. If the bear could solve three riddles, he would learn the truth about his true nature.
